verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email and calendar provider, so a built-in AI assistant that answers grounded questions across mail and calendar is a fair axis to judge. Nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail ships one. The JMAP API and API tokens are developer building blocks for constructing such an assistant, and mail search is an adjacent feature; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
